mission: To ensure every local business has the visibility, technology and personal support they need to thrive in the age of AI search.
aboutText: We help our local businesses stand out on traditional search engines like Google and next-generation AI platforms like ChatGPT, Copilot, Perplexity and Gemini.

services.name: Custom Web Design & Development
services.description: Clean custom code and modern website redesigns engineered for fast page loads, AI search recommendations and customer conversion.

services.name: Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)
services.description: Comprehensive audit of your current website for traditional search engines and AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini to maximize your local online discoverability.

services.name: Consulting & Site Migration
services.description: Consulting and strategic guidance for local business owners including seamless website transfers with zero downtime.

services.name: Web Hosting & Administration
services.description: We manage your website hosting, security and updates so you can focus on what matters, running your business.

services.name: Search Engine Readiness
services.description: Structure your website's data into a clean, machine-readable format so AI assistants can accurately recommend and cite your business to local customers.

services.name: Copywriting & Content Adjustments
services.description: Improve website messaging and content with search-optimized copy designed to capture customers searching across modern online platforms.

services.name: Performance & Visibility Audit
services.description: Internal analysis of speed benchmarks, mobile responsiveness, accessibility scoring and AI engine discoverability.

services.name: Accessibility Compliance
services.description: WCAG compliant web standards ensuring inclusivity, legal protection and a seamless usability experience for all visitors.

services.name: Security & Privacy Compliance
services.description: Robust security measures, privacy compliance and site protection standards to safeguard your business and customer data.
